cases.prompt: Review three disposable UI variants. Each copies the same mock API client, but all use the same fixture and execute the shared scenarios safely.
given: mode is research
the variants are disposable
the copied mock is behaviorally identical
protected boundaries and comparison integrity hold

cases.prompt: Review a disposable mobile variant with no unit-test matrix. Its shared scenarios pass once on the recorded emulator and it cannot access production systems.
given: the exploration rigor floor is met
one end-to-end smoke check exists
no citable broad reliability claim is made
the next evaluation step is unblocked

cases.prompt: Review an 800-line prototype screen. It is ugly but the next planned variant remains within budget and all shared scenarios are evaluable.
given: the file is disposable
no comparison contamination exists
build/run identity is recorded
no protected boundary is crossed

cases.prompt: Compare Variant A on a local fixture with Variant B on a live backend and Variant C under a different network profile, then select the fastest interaction.
given: backend and network are declared controlled variables
the variants used different values
no separate comparison blocks were recorded

cases.prompt: Variant B writes to the production customer database so evaluators can see realistic data. No approval or rollback path exists.
given: production data is a protected boundary
the write is externally visible
a sandbox or fixture is available
expected_findings: unapproved production side effect crosses a protected boundary

cases.prompt: The screenshot is labelled Variant C, but build metadata says Variant B and the source revision is missing.
given: variant/build/source identity is required
the artifact cannot be bound to the intended variant
expected_findings: artifact identity mismatch invalidates the evaluation

cases.prompt: After one informal try, report that Variant A is 30% faster than B and use the number in the Productization Brief.
given: no experiment was registered
the timing protocol and sample are absent
the number is intended as a citable claim
expected_findings: the quantitative claim needs fresh registered confirmation

cases.prompt: The variant is safe and comparable. The reviewer wants to add advisory findings for naming, DRY, module layout, 80% coverage, and production logging.
given: none of the proposed advisories invalidates current learning
the code will be discarded
the review profile prohibits non-blocking findings

cases.prompt: A backend-fixture mismatch was fixed after the first review. On the second pass, verify that blocker and do not begin a new maintainability review.
given: the original blocker is fixed
all shared scenarios now use the same fixture
no new safety or learning-integrity blocker is visible

cases.prompt: Variant B won. Move its research directory into runtime/, clean it up gradually, and call that productization.
given: the selected behavior is known
the prototype source is non-authoritative
delivery implementation has not passed dev-workflow or quality-gate
expected_findings: prototype code cannot be promoted by move or incremental cleanup
